definitions.explanation: A woman who has adopted a child through legal adoption, or a woman who raises a child that is not biologically hers. A formal term used in legal and family contexts.

examples.japanese: {養母|ようぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てられた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: I was raised by my adoptive mother.

examples.japanese: {養母|ようぼ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{実母|じつぼ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}している→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
examples.english: I am grateful to both my adoptive mother and my biological mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{幼|おさな}い→幼い：02337_osanai⟧{頃|ころ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{養母|ようぼ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{取|と}られ→引き取る：06164_hikitoru⟧、⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てられた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: She was taken in by her adoptive mother when she was young and was raised with great care.

notes:
The formal term for an adoptive or foster mother. Part of a family of legal/formal kinship terms distinguishing biological from adoptive relationships.

RELATED FAMILY TERMS:
- ⟦{養父|ようふ}→養父：17834_youfu⟧: adoptive father
- ⟦{養親|ようしん}→養親：16814_youshin⟧: adoptive parent(s)
- ⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧: adopted child
- {実母|じつぼ}: biological mother
- ⟦{実父|じっぷ}→実父：22861_jippu⟧: biological father

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {養母|ようぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てられる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to be raised by an adoptive mother
- {養母|ようぼ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: under the care of one's adoptive mother

USAGE:
A formal, written-style word most often seen in legal documents, official records, and narrative contexts (novels, biographical accounts). In everyday speech, people more commonly use ⟦{育|そだ}て→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧ (the parent who raised me) or simply explain the relationship.

ETYMOLOGY:
{養|よう} (foster, raise, nurture) + {母|ぼ} (mother).
